title: Music Theory Foundations
description: Sound as elements, then intervals, scales, modes, rhythm, and meter. Harmony as a craft waits until these names are honest. Built to support later heavy-music work, not a conservatory recital track.

sourceReferences.title: MIT 21M.051 Fundamentals of Music
sourceReferences.notes: Elements and rhythm/pitch before major/minor, then functional harmony last. Ear and notation travel with the theory.

sourceReferences.title: Berklee Guitar Fundamentals
sourceReferences.notes: Technique and basic harmonic literacy that death-metal construction should assume, not duplicate.
